# Vendored hummingbird-websocket

This directory is vendored from the official
[`hummingbird-project/hummingbird-websocket`](https://github.com/hummingbird-project/hummingbird-websocket)
repository at tag `2.6.0` (commit
`716c54294152c6d3301a6239a1d74db57cbcd6dc`).

The upstream `LICENSE` is retained. The only local source change is the
`swift-websocket` dependency in `Package.swift`, which points to the patched
`../swift-websocket` copy vendored in this directory's parent.
